method: Recompute from the sealed wall-family adjacency/list definition only; do not import the primary result's theorem prose.

peel_equivalence: Every ordinary z_e has full list [4] and exactly two neighbors outside Z_n.
The special z* has full list [4] and exactly three neighbors outside Z_n.
Thus after any proper coloring of G_n-Z_n, every z_e has at least one available color.
Z_n is stable, so choices for different z_e are independent.
Hence every coloring of G_n-Z_n extends to G_n.
replay.reconstruction_runtime: Each z_e inspects at most three neighbor colors; total O(|Z_n|).
core_coloring_check: Every declared core edge has differently colored endpoints; no other core edges exist.
message_check: For singleton ordinary component C={z_e}, any F with |F|<=3 leaves at least one color, so mu_C(F)=1.
For singleton special C={z*}, any F with |F|<=3 leaves at least one color, so mu_C(F)=1.
Therefore every reachable component message is tautological.

limitations: No theorem that arbitrary residual Y0 components have trivial messages.
No theorem that mu_C(F) is polynomial-time computable in general.
No theorem that component messages compose independently in general.
No full L2 repair or Lemma11 P7 lift.
